advancements.meridian_progression.cultiv: Cultivation
Qi drifts between heaven and earth, and meridians run through every body. The road begins with a tattered set of notes.
Qi Meridian Notes
Dungeons, abandoned mineshafts, desert and jungle temples often keep old fragments at the bottom of their chests; now and then a skeleton carries one too.
Inner Vision
Only by turning your gaze inward can you see where you are hurt and which meridians are open. This fragment lies in the same places as the notes.
Gathering Qi
Without breathing practice, not a wisp of true essence stays in the body. The art of gathering qi is mostly hidden in chests in dungeons and abandoned mineshafts.
Middle Jiao
The way to break through the middle jiao was hidden deep inside desert and jungle temples.
The First Channel
Breathe and guide your qi as the notes teach, and slowly force a closed meridian open.
Eight Meridians Open
The lung and large intestine meridians of both arms, the stomach and spleen meridians of both legs: only when all eight are open and whole can you break through.
Refining True Qi

With the middle jiao fragment read, circulate qi through the eight meridians, then draw on the essence stored in their walls and push through the middle jiao in one breath: wandering qi condenses into true qi.
True Qi Scroll
Those who broke through to true qi left accounts behind. A copy sometimes lies in chests at pillager outposts, woodland mansions and stronghold libraries.
People on the Road
Villagers, wandering traders, pillagers, vindicators, evokers, swamp witches... everyone in this world carries qi, and every blow they throw is a technique.
